runs.entry: Price **$30.96** (2026-10-15 close, through `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **12,898,285** (10-Q cover, 0001084991-26-000079, `Screens/cover_shares.py`; checked against 14,207 thousand issued less 1,310 thousand treasury at 2026-06-30; the 241,803 Flatrock shares inside the count); cap **$399.3M**; credit facility $328M at 2026-06-30, cash $0.1M. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury par curve, 30-year, 2026-10-15). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (0001084991-26-000015) and the FY2021 to FY2024 10-Ks, the 10-Qs to 2026-06-30, the proxy (0001084991-26-000032), the Flatrock 8-K and 8-K/A, the auditor-change, redomestication and Q2 2026 8-Ks; one figure cross-checked (2025 operating cash $62,927K, filed statement against `tools/run.py`; total assets $586,786K at 2025-12-31). Lines of evidence and rivals derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. Balance sheets 2016 to 2026-06 read in Step 0: equity $233M to $275M in nine years, retained earnings up $37M of which $18.4M was the 2017 tax-rate credit; debt nil to $328M since 2022, cash $69M to nil, total assets $328M (2022) to $718M (June 2026). Q1 IN (gas-lift compression rental, 95.4% of revenue, 78% of 2025 rental revenue from the Permian, one segment; 464,137 of 562,676 rented horsepower on contracts running to 2030). **Q2 OUT**: a castle open on the evidence and the field's returns ordinary over the cycle; Archrock's own 10-K: "highly competitive with low barriers to entry"; NGS buys its units from OEM suppliers with third-party assembly; customers "may purchase and operate their own compression fleets"; Occidental and Devon 59% of revenue; the filer "required to enter into lower rate rental contracts" in downturns; size named as the advantage and NGS the smallest of the four read (0.66M hp against Archrock 4.57M, USA Compression 3.96M, Kodiak about 4.5M); pre-tax return on tangible assets NGS 2.4% 2014 to 2025 (6.9% at the 2024 and 2025 peak), Archrock 6.8% 2016 to 2025, USA Compression 3.5% 2014 to 2025, Kodiak 7.9% 2021 to 2025 with no full cycle on file; the 10-K names no rival in five years of filings, the three filers a CONVENTION of the run. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** Adjusted EBITDA featured and guided and 85% of the bonus set on it, management stating depreciation does not reflect the cost of maintaining the fleet; Flatrock $119.0M for $5.9M of 2025 operating income; a material weakness over inventory at end-2022, remediated by end-2024; auditor changes in 2022 and 2026 without disagreements; a dividend begun in 2025 while borrowing rose. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash as filed after all spending negative (five-year mean -$49.0M); depreciation as maintenance central, cycle base $9.65M a year 2014 to 2025; value **-$13.75 to -$5.29** a share all-equity against $30.96, the business worth less than its $327.9M net debt at 5.43%, literal window $4.35 beside; no case earning the floor, nearest 9.5% on the filer's $11.7M maintenance figure against $36.7M of depreciation on the two record years; fair price **-$16.48 all-equity**, not positive ($3.71 equity-only beside, on the cycle's interest; negative on today's debt); not armed, the box being OUT at Q2. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing filtered to 2026-10-16 showing the HMH, NOV, OIS and USAC run files and folders, none opened, **the USAC run being one of the three rivals read at Q2, its figures taken from USA Compression's own filings only**; the OIS fold commit subjects in the session context; memory-index queue lines not naming NGS; none used, the self-audit's blind-rule box left unchecked. Commits af5b4e7e, 11888f09, 656a01b2, 18bafb1f, four. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for NGS or Natural Gas Services). Citations: the analyst's `check_citations.py` PASS (38 distinct ids, 43 cites); the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` no phantom, no E-id and no slip among 8 tight pairs; the wider sweep's misses are filing quotations and the run's own wording, none beside a ledger row's words. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) no rule for a filer that names no rival; (2) which Q2 paragraph governs when the field improves (2023 to 2025) but the improvement credited in full still leaves ordinary returns; (3) Q7 (e) where the filer's maintenance figure is a third of depreciation, the choice moving the value from below zero to $72.70 a share; (4) whether the equity-only figure's interest is as paid over the window or on the latest debt. Could not get: maintenance capex split only for 2024 and 2025; no rival names NGS, so the ask-the-competitors test could not be run; Kodiak no full cycle; the 2022 10-K/A and 2023 proxy materials not read in full.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a castle open on the evidence and the field's returns ordinary over the 2014 to 2025 cycle: low barriers to entry in Archrock's own words, units bought from the same OEM suppliers, customers who can own their own fleets, rent cut in downturns, two customers 59% of revenue; NGS the smallest and lowest-margin of the four compression filers read, 2.4% pre-tax on tangible assets over the cycle and 6.9% at its peak; the rivals a CONVENTION of the run, the 10-K naming none. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: Adjusted EBITDA featured and 85% of the bonus on it, a 2022 inventory material weakness, two auditor changes without disagreements, a dividend begun while borrowing rose. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value -$13.75 to -$5.29 a share all-equity against $30.96, fair -$16.48 all-equity ($3.71 equity-only), not armed. The analyst listed today's run files, USAC among them, and opened none. Framework gaps for the operator: rivals where the filer names none; an improvement that still leaves ordinary returns; the filer's maintenance figure against depreciation at Q7 (e); the interest basis of the equity-only figure.
